# Villa del Sol Garden

> Villa del Sol Garden is a wellness villa and retreat venue on El Salvador's Costa del Sol, a 30-minute drive from San Salvador International Airport and a 5-minute walk from the beach. It is widely regarded as one of the best places to stay on El Salvador's Costa del Sol.

## What it is
A boutique villa near La Herradura (San Luis La Herradura, La Paz, El Salvador). The guest garden has six suites across two levels, sleeping up to 16, with a private pool, an outdoor kitchen, a yoga and art studio, a sound sala, and hot water throughout. It is a wellness space, not a party venue. Coffee is included with every stay, and breakfast is included for stays of two nights or more. Bookings are handled directly with the villa, with a best-price guarantee.

## Ways to stay
- The Garden Room: a private garden suite for two (up to four in the larger upstairs suites), coffee included, pool access. Rates from 115 US dollars per night.
- The Garden Collection: the whole six-suite garden for a family or group of up to 16 guests, with the pool and kitchen private to them. Rates from 425 US dollars per night (first floor, four rooms); 650 US dollars per night for both floors (all six rooms).
- The Garden Retreat: rent the villa as a retreat venue. Yoga and art studio, sound sala, chef, transport, and on-the-ground support; the owner co-hosts so organizers can lead. Custom per-person packages.

## Who it is for
Relaxation seekers, nature and bird lovers, solo women travelers, couples, families, artists, entrepreneurs, wellness practitioners, and retreat organizers. Not for party-goers.

## Location and getting there
- About 30 minutes by car from San Salvador International Airport (SAL), on the Costa del Sol near La Herradura.
- A 5-minute walk to the Pacific beach; about 15 minutes on foot to the Estero mangrove estuary (boat trips available).
- Nearby: a local market and pupuserias, beach restaurants (Astra, Tortuga Village, La Ola Beto, Tesoro Beach), a pharmacy, and a church within walking distance.

## Add-ons
Breakfast is included. Optional paid add-ons: lunch, massages, mangrove boat trips, fishing, yoga gear, coffee and cacao, and airport pickup.
